description: This file defines macros, templates, and functions related to command-line flags in the Abseil C++ library, including flag declaration, setting, getting, and reflection. It primarily contains macro definitions, template functions, and type aliases for managing flags.

classes.name: absl::Flag
classes.description: Template alias for internal flag representation, used for defining command-line flags.

methods.name: GetFlag
methods.description: Returns the value of a specified flag in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: SetFlag
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified flag in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: GetFlagReflectionHandle
methods.description: Returns reflection information for a given flag.
